newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.210pts to 103.200.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.210pts to 103.200.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.210 points in Tuesday's trading to 103.200 points, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.069 points to 2.827 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.240 points to 100.677, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.004 points to 2.367 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 8.355 points to 1,031.404.
